label: default_glass
reference_prompt: Create a close visual reference for old hand-made transparent glass used as a building material in a grounded dark-fantasy world. The pane material should remain highly transparent but carry faint physical evidence of imperfect manufacture: subtle waviness, tiny trapped bubbles, delicate thickness variation and a restrained cool-gray or greenish cast. Edges and surface variation should be readable without clouding the view through it. Avoid frosted glass, modern flawless float glass, heavy scratches, stained glass, mirror reflections or milky opacity. The defining quality is fragile imperfect transparency shaped by old craft, not surface decoration.
